errors.evidence: The description states that the maximum for the blue line (Germany) is reached around 2010. However, the plot shows that the highest point for this line occurs at the end of the period, in 2020. The value in 2020 (approx. 3.9%) is visibly higher than the local peak around 2010 (approx. 3.85%).
